e.summary_hk: 台灣保險業監管機構英文站：保險法規數據庫、保險資訊與統計、壽險商品與消費者保護
e.body: 台湾金融监督管理委员会保险局（Insurance Bureau, Financial Supervisory Commission，`ib.gov.tw/en/`）是**台湾保险业的监管机构**，英文站结构完整：About the IB / Our Director General / Organization、Bulletin Board 与 Press Release、**Important Measures**、**International Activities**、Enforcement（执法），法规侧提供 **Insurance Laws and Regulations DataBase** 与金管会法规数据库，数据侧提供 **Insurance Information and Statistics / Statistics** 与 **Life Insurance Product**（寿险商品）栏目，另有 Publications 与消费者保护专区（含金融消费者保护法）。对 RIAA：台湾是亚洲重要的寿险市场（寿险密度与渗透率长期居前），而本 wiki 此前只有**行业研究机构**口径（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]，台湾保险事业发展中心）——本词条补上**监管机构口径**，两者一「研究/行业」一「监管/法规」，正好覆盖台湾市场的两种信息需求；其法规数据库与寿险商品栏目对做**产品比较与监管比较**的作业特别有用；与中国（[[nfra-statistics]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] 一类的精算条例对照）、香港（[[hk-ia-statistics]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）构成大中华与东亚监管对照；适合作市场分析、法规比较与产品研究方向。
e.body_en: The Insurance Bureau of Taiwan’s Financial Supervisory Commission (`ib.gov.tw/en/`) is **Taiwan’s insurance regulator**, with a well-structured English site: About the IB / Our Director General / Organization, a bulletin board and press releases, **Important Measures**, **International Activities** and Enforcement; on the regulatory side it offers an **Insurance Laws and Regulations DataBase** and the FSC laws database, and on the data side an **Insurance Information and Statistics / Statistics** section plus a **Life Insurance Product** section, along with Publications and a consumer-protection area (including the Financial Consumer Protection Act). For RIAA: Taiwan is a major Asian life market (long among the leaders in life insurance density and penetration), and this wiki previously held only the **industry research institute** perspective ([[tii-taiwan-insurance]], the Taiwan Insurance Institute) — this entry adds the **regulator’s perspective**, giving one "research/industry" and one "regulatory/legal" source for the two information needs a Taiwan market study has; its laws database and life product sections are especially useful for **product comparison and regulatory comparison** assignments; with China ([[nfra-statistics]] and actuarial-regulation contrasts such as [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]), Hong Kong ([[hk-ia-statistics]]) and Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]]) it forms a Greater China and East Asia regulatory frame; suits market analysis, regulatory comparison and product research.
e.body_hk: 台灣金融監督管理委員會保險局（Insurance Bureau, Financial Supervisory Commission，`ib.gov.tw/en/`）是**台灣保險業的監管機構**，英文站結構完整：About the IB / Our Director General / Organization、Bulletin Board 與 Press Release、**Important Measures**、**International Activities**、Enforcement，法規側提供 **Insurance Laws and Regulations DataBase**，數據側提供 **Insurance Information and Statistics / Statistics** 與 **Life Insurance Product** 欄目，另有 Publications 與消費者保護專區。對 RIAA：台灣是亞洲重要的壽險市場，而本 wiki 此前只有**行業研究機構**口徑（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）——本詞條補上**監管機構口徑**，兩者覆蓋台灣市場的兩種資訊需求；其法規數據庫與壽險商品欄目對**產品比較與監管比較**作業特別有用；與中國（[[nfra-statistics]]）、香港（[[hk-ia-statistics]]）、韓國（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）構成大中華與東亞監管對照；適合作市場分析、法規比較與產品研究方向。
